{{Top|leg}}
'''Logic display sensors''', '''logic display systems''', or '''logic dispensers'''<ref name="GSWU">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]''</ref> were a form of [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] in [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that provided them visual indication of their computer control operations.<ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> [[Imaharatronics]] was a company that produced logic display sensors for droids in the decades before the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], including for the [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]].<ref name="CompleteDictionary">{{SWArchive|url=eu/lit/ref/f20061031/index.html|text=Building a ''Complete Visual Dictionary''}}</ref>
